constraints.rule: No bubbles in any channel after each fill step and before readout
constraints.rationale: Bubbles and incomplete filling are recognised microfluidic errors; bubbles can cause false signals during the immunoassay.

constraints.rule: Channels completely filled after each fill step (no incomplete filling or channel-obstructing gas slug)
constraints.rationale: Incomplete filling is a recognised microfluidic error alongside bubbles.
Too short or too long incubation causes under- or over-adsorption, artifacts, false concentration readings and large replicate errors.
